analysis_resumptions_state_valid.name: analysis_resumptions_state_valid
analysis_resumptions_state_valid.value: ("analysis_job_resumptions"."configuration_state" = 'legacy_unknown' AND "analysis_job_resumptions"."next_quick_version_id" IS NULL AND "analysis_job_resumptions"."next_deep_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("analysis_job_resumptions"."configuration_state" = 'versioned' AND "analysis_job_resumptions"."next_quick_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "analysis_job_resumptions"."next_deep_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

analysis_jobs_configuration_state.name: analysis_jobs_configuration_state
analysis_jobs_configuration_state.value: ("analysis_jobs"."configuration_state" = 'legacy_unknown' AND "analysis_jobs"."quick_model_version_id" IS NULL AND "analysis_jobs"."deep_model_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("analysis_jobs"."configuration_state" = 'versioned' AND "analysis_jobs"."quick_model_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "analysis_jobs"."deep_model_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

analysis_jobs_trade_date_valid.name: analysis_jobs_trade_date_valid
analysis_jobs_trade_date_valid.value: CASE WHEN "analysis_jobs"."trade_date" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$' THEN ("analysis_jobs"."trade_date"::date IS NOT NULL) ELSE false END

credit_transactions_v2_balance_valid.name: credit_transactions_v2_balance_valid
credit_transactions_v2_balance_valid.value: ("credit_transactions"."ledger_sequence" IS NULL AND "credit_transactions"."balance_after" IS NULL) OR ("credit_transactions"."ledger_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_transactions"."balance_after" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_transactions"."ledger_sequence" > 0 AND "credit_transactions"."ledger_sequence" <= 9007199254740991 AND "credit_transactions"."balance_after" >= 0)

daily_prices_ohlcv_valid.name: daily_prices_ohlcv_valid
daily_prices_ohlcv_valid.value: "daily_prices"."low" > 0 AND "daily_prices"."high" >= "daily_prices"."low" AND "daily_prices"."open" BETWEEN "daily_prices"."low" AND "daily_prices"."high" AND "daily_prices"."close" BETWEEN "daily_prices"."low" AND "daily_prices"."high" AND "daily_prices"."high" < 10000000000000000 AND "daily_prices"."volume" >= 0

instruments_verified_identity.name: instruments_verified_identity
instruments_verified_identity.value: "instruments"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("instruments"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."timezone" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."exchange" <> 'UNRESOLVED')

model_versions_values_valid.name: model_versions_values_valid
model_versions_values_valid.value: "llm_model_config_versions"."version" > 0 AND "llm_model_config_versions"."price_unit_tokens" > 0 AND ("llm_model_config_versions"."input_price" IS NULL OR "llm_model_config_versions"."input_price" >= 0) AND ("llm_model_config_versions"."cache_price" IS NULL OR "llm_model_config_versions"."cache_price" >= 0) AND ("llm_model_config_versions"."output_price" IS NULL OR "llm_model_config_versions"."output_price" >= 0) AND jsonb_typeof("llm_model_config_versions"."model_options") = 'object' AND "llm_model_config_versions"."provenance" IN ('configured','historical_snapshot') AND "llm_model_config_versions"."encrypted_api_key" LIKE 'sdkey:%'
